title: 군검찰단의 조직에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Military Prosecutors' Offices of Each Armed Service)
(1) A prosecutors' office established under the Chief of Staff of each armed service pursuant to Article 36 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "Military Prosecutors' Office of each armed service") shall administer affairs concerning military prosecutors and military prosecution of the relevant armed service.
(2) Each Military Prosecutors' Office shall have a High Prosecution Division, an Ordinary Prosecution Division and a Human Rights Protection Supervisor.
(3) Matters necessary for the organization, jurisdiction and allocation of duties of each Military Prosecutors' Office, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be determined by the Chief of Staff of the relevant armed service.
